claim_rule.effective_status: A node is BLOCKED_BY_UPSTREAM iff at least one predecessor has non-PASS effective status; otherwise its local status is preserved.
claim_rule.claim_frontier: All maximal substantive claim nodes (L1-L5; L0 is the execution-feasibility root) with effective PASS status are reported; incomparable branches are retained.
claim_rule.minimal_blockers: For each blocked node, report the closest non-PASS local ancestors and retain all incomparable blockers.

protocol_invariants.evidence_conservation: local evidence is immutable during effective-status derivation
protocol_invariants.blocking_monotonicity: adding downstream observations cannot promote a descendant claim while any transitive prerequisite of that descendant remains non-PASS; independent branches are not constrained
protocol_invariants.versioned_repair_record: a repair record must carry a version identifier; cross-record uniqueness and parent-object linkage are repository-level checks
protocol_invariants.idempotence: repeated derivation on the same graph and local vector returns the same result
